When Timmy got home, his mom asked him why he was crying. Timmy said he lost his wallet and couldn't find it. His mom was worried and called the police. The police came to take Timmy's wallet and put it in a safe place. Timmy was very upset and cried a lot. 
Timmy never found his wallet and never went back to the park. He learned that it's not a good idea to leave his wallet behind.
